main_mechanism: Gate automatic fanout-aware cross-die placement weights by the observed cross-die net fraction: apply the 1.30/1.15/1.05 factors only when cross-die nets are at most 12% of all PlaceDB nets; otherwise keep incoming unit weights. An explicit non-unit cross_die_net_weight remains authoritative.
physical_invariants: Net weights remain finite and positive; only nets with assigned endpoints on both dies are candidates for automatic scaling.
When the cross-die fraction exceeds 12%, automatic weighting is disabled and cross-die weights remain at their incoming values.

tradeoff_statement: The guard gives up potential cross-die timing pull on high-fraction designs but avoids over-constraining a large shared-net set and adding local congestion. It stores one cross-die net-ID list and performs one additional linear weighting pass, adding O(cross-die net count) memory and bounded runtime; it adds no placement iterations or changes to density, legality, area or power. The 12% threshold is an empirically derived proxy rather than a calibrated criticality model.
